document.title: Situation in A. Handwritten CC CPSU Politburo Decision to Introduce Troops into Afghanistan, December 12, 1979
document.publisher: National Security Archive (GWU), Afghanistan: Lessons from the Last War
document.note: Handwritten Politburo decision signed by Politburo members, "On the Situation in A". It is the only documentary evidence of the highly secret decision to send Soviet troops into Afghanistan.

events.description: CC CPSU Politburo resolution ratifying evaluations and measures on the situation in "A" (Afghanistan) proposed by Andropov, Ustinov and Gromyko, who are entrusted with executing and reporting on them.
CC CPSU Politburo ratified the evaluations and measures set forth by Andropov, Ustinov and Gromyko concerning the situation in Afghanistan, and authorized them to execute them.
Some Politburo members signed the resolution (dated 25 December).
Shcherbitsky and others signed the resolution (dated 26 December).

key_claims: The Politburo ratified the evaluations and measures on the situation in Afghanistan proposed by Andropov, Ustinov and Gromyko.
Andropov, Ustinov and Gromyko were given authority to make non-essential amendments and to execute the measures.
Questions requiring Central Committee decision were to be promptly brought to the Politburo.
The resolution was top secret, stamped 'Special File', and signed by Politburo members including some on 25-26 December 1979.
